items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: Tom Mack who did Harry James and a lot of big bands, Woody Herman

ctx.x: No, not at all. I mean I worked with some great producers, I mean going back to Dot Records, Tom Mack who did Harry James and a lot of big bands, Woody Herman and I got really tight with some of those producers at Dot and it was really great to do those. I worked with Tom Mack, we worked with somebody in the big bands, he was in Glenn Miller’s original band. He was a producer at Dot Records. And you know he was just great to work with. They were great musicians so it was really great to work with him. Guys like…
You used to call them what?
